newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes mixed after new highs set.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes mixed after new highs set.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mixed with the market sagging late on profit taking and local selling after new contract highs were set in early dealings, traders said.
"There was some selling overhanging the market and that spooked locals a little," a trader said. "But there was buying showing up under the market by the close."
The new contract high for January is $11.41 per cwt, up from the previous high of $11.39 set Tuesday.
Rice closed three cents per cwt lower to 1/2 cent higher, with January down three at $11.36.
